# Now 2.13.63
- Line changes now feel the same each time. The distance a line springs past its resting place was already fixed, but the time taken barely changed with distance, so two long wrapped lines in a row covered twice the ground of a short change in about the same moment and moved twice as fast. Longer changes now take proportionally longer, so every line change moves at close to the same speed.

# Now 2.13.62
- The blurred background is no longer rebuilt when it does not need to be. It was being generated in full, on the graphics card, every time the artwork was republished, and then discarded if the track had not actually changed.

# Now 2.13.61
- Clicking a lyric now moves there once, cleanly. After any control action the app re-reads the player three times over the following second and a half to confirm what happened, and those reads could still report the position from before the jump. The lyrics followed each reading, so a single click could move the highlight three times, each with its own animation. Clicking backwards was worst, and would do it even one line at a time. The app now trusts its own jump until the player genuinely catches up.
